notes: What's New in 0.1.2: Production Runner 0.1.2 makes the public beta simpler: Home, Script (Write and Breakdown, with Cast ID and Reports), Shots, the Scheduler, Contacts, Locations and Tasks each do their job in fewer places.

Find Elements: In Script's Breakdown, More ▸ Find Elements… replaces Auto-Tag. It lists the words in your script that match elements you already tagged, scene by scene. Untick any you don't want, then press Tag.
A shorter Breakdown menu: Breakdown's More menu has fewer items. Find Duplicates is in Cast ID's More menu.
Tasks: one list: Tasks is one list now. A done task shows the day it was done, and Filter ▸ Status ▸ Done lists your finished tasks, newest first.

Locations: Scouting and clearances: Scouting's questions about the name, address, site contact, permission, power, safety and nearest hospital now show the same answers as Info, so you type them once. The count of clearances pending only counts approved locations.
Shoot days in your calendar: The Scheduler's Export menu can save your dated shooting days as a calendar file (.ics) for Apple, Google or Outlook Calendar.

Scheduler: change and drag strips: Change a banner, call time, lunch, off day or day break after adding it: double-click it, or right-click it and choose the first item. Double-click a day's END OF DAY line, or right-click it and choose Day Notes…, to change that day's notes. Select several strips and drag any one of them to move them all together. A new call time opens its day, under the DAY band.
Off days between days: An off day now shows between the END OF DAY line of the day it follows and the next day, with the date it takes.
Sharper text on Windows: On Windows, Production Runner's text uses Segoe UI, so it is sharp at 100% display scaling.

A simpler Home and Account: Home's tiles no longer show a red outline (it only marked changes made by other people). Settings ▸ Account no longer has a profile photo; it comes back when productions can be shared.

Fixes: Set Availability… and photo captions can be undone. A person with days off reads "Currently available" on the days they are free. Clearing a shot's cast keeps it clear in the Full Shot List and the CSV. Pressing Return in Day notes, a task's title or Assigned to, or a scene field in Script's Breakdown saves once, so one Undo takes it back. Task Details ▸ Change History shows your edits. Duplicate Production, backups and restores keep each task's history and every trip, with its dates, budget and cover, even an empty one. The Tasks list header says the order it shows.

Scheduler fixes: Move to Day, Cut, Copy, Paste and Remove from Film now work on strips under Unscheduled. A quick click with Command (Ctrl on Windows) or Shift held adds to the selection instead of being missed.

To install: Open Download Page downloads the update in your browser. Open the downloaded file, drag Production Runner onto Applications and choose Replace. Your productions are kept. From this version on, updates install inside the app.
